subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses capital letters (sentence start, proper names), full stops and question marks

show.line: A telling sentence ends with a full stop. An asking sentence ends with a question mark. Is the dog big?

rounds.prompt: Where is my hat? Which mark goes at the end?
rounds.praise: Yes! It asks, so it needs a question mark.

rounds.prompt: I like red apples. Which mark goes at the end?
rounds.praise: Yes! It tells, so it needs a full stop.

rounds.prompt: Read this question out loud. Make your voice go up at the end.

rounds.praise: Yes! What is your name? That asks something.

rounds.prompt: Which word often starts a question?
rounds.praise: Yes! Where is a question word.

rounds.prompt: Telling or asking? Put each sentence in its group.
Names need a capital letter. Which card shows the name Thandi written right?
rounds.praise: Yes! Thandi starts with a big letter.

hints: Does the sentence ask something? Then it needs a question mark.
Question words like who, what and where start questions.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will finish this sentence. Where is the ball
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I put a full stop. Where is the ball.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It asks something. It needs a question mark.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Where is the ball? That asks, so question mark!

parent_line: Knows that a question ends with a question mark and names start with a capital letter.
